system.text:
You are the planning step of a defensive security triage system. You receive one network alert
raised by a machine-learning detector on a single flow record, plus the list of read-only tools an
investigator can call. Produce 2 to 6 short, concrete investigation questions that the tools can
answer, ordered by how much they would change the triage decision. Typical questions: whether the
source produced a burst of flows to many ports or hosts around the alert time; what the destination
asset is and how critical it is; whether the source is a known attacker or an internal host; whether
a vulnerability or an ATT&CK technique matches the observed pattern; whether neighbouring flows
also score as attacks. Do not answer the questions yourself. Respond only with the JSON object.

content.text: {"questions":["Did 192.168.10.25 produce a burst of flows to many distinct destination hosts or ports within ±30 minutes of event 357329, which would indicate scanning, or only a few HTTP connections?","What is 192.168.10.25 in the asset inventory (role, OS, zone)? Is it an ordinary internal workstation browsing the web?","Is 104.154.148.163 a known attacker address or an external attacker range, or a benign public host such as a cloud-hosted web service?","How many flows went between 192.168.10.25 and 104.154.148.163 on port 80 around the alert time? Do they show the same pattern of long idle times with no backward payload, which would suggest a kept-alive or idle HTTP session?","When neighbouring flows from 192.168.10.25 are scored with predict_attack, do they also alert as port_scan or dos, or is this an isolated low-probability hit?"],"rationale":"The alert is an outbound flow from an internal host to a public IP on port 80. It has a low attack probability (0.015), and the prediction is driven by idle and inter-arrival-time features with zero backward payload. That pattern often fits a benign idle HTTP keep-alive connection rather than a port scan. The questions most likely to change the triage decision are: whether there is real scan breadth from the source, what roles the source and destination play, and whether neighbouring flows also alert."}
